patch.value: ## Scope\n\nDeliver one coherent current-Core and production-readiness tranche: typed primary/secondary target topology, bounded related-registry use, current compatible dependency and PM tooling updates, complete docs/help/schema/tests, privacy-safe live acceptance, and automatic-release dry-run proof without publishing.
Add complete target topology and restore secure release automation
Expose Home Assistant target secondary-entity extraction through the typed agent workflow and restore the mandatory security and automatic-release gates blocked by the current transitive advisory.

Typed target extraction and related discovery can explicitly include non-primary entities using the official current-Core schema; all formats/help/schema/docs remain correct; dependency audit, exact 100/100/100/100 coverage, docstrings, static/security gates, setup acceptance, live read-only E2E, and automatic-release dry run pass; no credentials or live identifiers enter Git or PM

All-status PM duplicate search, full prior target/release lineage, Core 2026.8.1 tagged source, current official docs, live 2026.7.4 behavior, scheduled failure logs, and latest compatible package versions have been inspected.
Give agents accurate target topology while keeping every mandatory production gate operational.
Improves automation planning correctness and unblocks secure daily releases.
A reviewed, merged, fully verified current-Core discovery and release-safety tranche with no publication.
The typed target helper omits an official response-selection control and the scheduled release/security workflows are currently failing on a high advisory.
